segments.text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
And one cried unto another, and said,

segments.speaker: Seraphim
segments.text: Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

footnotes.text: + one…: Heb. this cried to this
+ the whole…: Heb. his glory is the fulness of the whole earth

segments.text: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
¶ Then said I,

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

footnotes.text: + having…: Heb. and in his hand a live coal

segments.text: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said,

segments.speaker: Seraphim
segments.text: Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.

footnotes.text: + laid…: Heb. caused it to touch

segments.text: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying,

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
Then said I,

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: Here am I; send me.
¶ And he said,

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

footnotes.text: + indeed, but understand: or, without ceasing, etc: Heb. in hearing, etc

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
Then said I,

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: Lord, how long?
And he answered,

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: ¶ But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

footnotes.text: + and it…: or, when it is returned, and hath been broused
